_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Further#000.dst: 俺を置いていかないでくれ！

A Journey Further#001.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#001.dst: {u}、いい知らせだ。もうこの上ないくらい回復した。

A Journey Further#002.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#002.dst: >そして英雄は古の予言者の目をくらます。幸運を。

A Journey Further#003.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#003.dst: よし、行くぞ。道すがら、この旅についてもっと話してやる。
A Journey Further#003.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#005.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#005.dst: できるだけ道に沿って先導してくれ、俺はお前についていく。
A Journey Further#005.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#007.dst: 止まれ！ 今の音が聞こえたか？
A Journey Further#007.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.dst: 待ち伏せだ！ 気を抜くな、{u}！
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#010.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#010.dst: よくやった。王を倒したから他の奴らは逃げたみたいだな。運がよかった。
A Journey Further#010.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#011.dst: 待て、{u}、どうした？ 大丈夫か？
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#012.src: Oh, no no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#012.dst: あぁ、まずいまずいまずい！ これに効く薬がある、どこだ、どこだ、あった！ ほら、飲んで！
A Journey Further#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#013.dst: 奴らのどれかが傷口から感染したんだな…この辺りは何もかも危険で気分が悪くなる。
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#014.dst: 最悪を想定して、役立ちそうな物は全部持ってきた。先を急ぐぞ。
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#015.dst: Aledar と本道を進み続ける。

A Journey Further#018.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#018.dst: 俺が…しばらく先導する。少しの…間だけでも。奴らにお前を―
A Journey Further#018.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#020.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#020.dst: …うっ…すまん。ただ…少し休ませてくれ。
A Journey Further#020.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#021.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#021.dst: {u}…わかってくれ。奴らにお前を傷つけさせるわけにはいかないんだ。
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#022.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#022.dst: 念を押しておく…俺たちは、この道の果てへ行かなきゃならない、2人揃って。
A Journey Further#022.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#024.dst: よし。今はこれが精一杯だ。行こう。
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#025.dst: あれ？ 何だ…今のは…なぜ急に…
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#026.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#026.dst: 大丈夫だ、ただ…なぜ急にこんなに心が空っぽになったように感じたんだ…？
A Journey Further#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...
A Journey Further#027.dst: 謎の力に押し戻された…

A Journey Further#028.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#028.dst: まずい、何かが来てるぞ…{u}！ やっつけろ、今の俺じゃ自分の身も守れそうにない！
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#029.dst: Radiated Spider から Aledar を守る。

A Journey Further#030.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#030.dst: はあ…まだ本調子じゃないが…少なくとも自分の身は守れる。
A Journey Further#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#031.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why do I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#031.dst: 胃が空っぽで吐くこともできねえ…なぜまだこんなにもめまいがするんだ？ 薬が効くかも…
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.dst: うーん。いや、これじゃない…
A Journey Further#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#033.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#033.dst: うえっ、ぺっ！ さっき吐いた物のほうがマシな味だった…
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ...hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#034.dst: はあ…これだ。ところで何の薬だったんだ…育毛剤？ なんでそんなもんが効いたんだ？
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#035.dst: そういえば、俺が攻撃したあの獣がどうなったか見たか？ ついてこい。
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#036.dst: 任務の資料によれば、これは「虚空の穴」と呼ばれているらしい。一種のポータルだ。
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#037.dst: ポータルは奇妙に繋がりあってるらしいが、俺が叩き込んだ獣があっちから出てきたってことは…
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 見てろ。反対側から出てくるぞ。
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#039.dst: よし、いいぞ！ 少なくとも出口は毎回同じだな。今度はお前の番だ。
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.dst: 虚空の穴 に飛び込む。

A Journey Further#041.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#041.dst: Aledar と小道を進み続ける。

A Journey Further#042.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#042.dst: この話をするのは、一つ見かけたら、すぐにもっと出てくるからだ。見慣れておいたほうがいい。
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#044.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#044.dst: 俺たちはここでの困難をひどく甘く見ていた。俺たちっていうのは、俺と Elphie と Lucio のことだ…
A Journey Further#044.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#045.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#045.dst: みんな準備不足で自惚れていた。お前がいなければ、今ごろ俺も死んでいただろう。
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#046.dst: 最初はお前を連れて行くのに躊躇っていた。でも、お前がこの任務に一番適任だって十分すぎるほど分からされたよ。
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#047.dst: …この地図は古すぎると気づくべきだった。道は地図に載ってないこの棘の壁の中を通ってる！
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#048.dst: この棘は最近現れたんだろう…それなら、叩き壊せるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#049.dst: {u}、同時に呪文を撃ってみて！ こいつを突き破ろう！
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#051.dst: …ぐっ…な、なんでこんなに硬いんだ…？
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#052.dst: 俺はなんてバカなんだ…死ぬところだった。任務を台無しにするところだった…
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#053.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#053.dst: すまん、ここからは一人で行ってくれ。今は一歩も動けそうにない。
A Journey Further#053.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#054.dst: さっき言った通り、この辺りには 虚空の穴 がたくさんある。…それでトゲを越えられるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#055.dst: もっと早く思いつけばよかった…お前が越えたら、二人で…ええと、何かできるはずだ。
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#056.dst: ただ…行き先には気をつけろ。虚空の穴 はどこに通じているかわからない。お前でも手に負えないようなとても危険な場所に出るかもしれない。そうならないよう祈ってる…
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#057.dst: すぐそこに 虚空の穴 がある、まずはそれを試そう。入ってみてくれ。お前にかかってる。
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#058.dst: 虚空の穴 を使ってトゲの障壁の裏側へ回り込む

A Journey Further#059.src: An explosion has occurred somewhere in the arena...
A Journey Further#059.dst: アリーナのどこかで爆発が起きた……

A Journey Further#060.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#060.dst: Aledar がトゲの障壁の反対側へ行ける方法を探す。

A Journey Further#061.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#061.dst: …待て、{u}？ そっち側に行けたのか…？ よくやった…
A Journey Further#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#062.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#062.dst: 何をしたんだ、とにかくトゲにひびが入ってるようだ、こっちからも見える。
A Journey Further#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#063.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#063.dst: 少し回復した…もう一回呪文を試そう。同時に撃てば、突破口が開けるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#064.dst: もう頭をトゲに打ちつけたりはしない。約束する。
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 先にやってくれ。お前の呪文が聞こえたらすぐ俺も撃つ。
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#066.dst: よかった、うまくいった……あそこがこの旅の目的地、異形の展望台だ。
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#067.dst: ここからが一番つらいところだ…来てくれ。お前にいてもらう必要がある。
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#068.dst: あそこの刃…あれは生贄のためのものだ。あの門が閉まってるだろ？
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#069.dst: 展望台への扉を開くには、強い魂を生贄に捧げなきゃならない。
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#070.dst: 俺たちは…最初から話しておくべきだった。お前と Lucio に。Elphie と俺は、知っていたんだ。ここにこれがあると。
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think- we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#071.dst: 俺たちは…誰を生贄にするか決めていなかった。ここに着いてから決めるのが一番だと話し合った。そして二人とも、僕らのどちらかになるとわかっていたと思う。
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
A Journey Further#072.dst: …彼女なら自分がやると言い張っただろうな。二人とも、この世に心残りがあったとしても…
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#073.dst: もうどうでもいい。残ったのは俺たちだけだ。町に着いてからずっと考えていたお前が俺を生贄にするんだ。反論は受けつけない。
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: I mean...look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#074.dst: だって…今の俺のありさまを見てくれ、{u}！ もう死にかけてるし、お前は俺が万全でも、ずっと強いって分かった。
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#075.dst: ほら。俺の持ち物を全部持ってけ。エメラルドと、ダンジョンの鍵だ。俺にはもう使えねえからな。
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#076.dst: 塔の頂上には…何かがいる。それが何なのか正確にはわからない。けど、そいつがお前のの行く手を阻むはずだ。
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But...find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#077.dst: 障壁を破るにはそいつを倒すしかない。でも…手を貸してくれる兵士を探せ。一人じゃ絶対に勝てない。
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#078.dst: …じゃあ、もう先延ばしはやめよう。血が止まらないんだ。
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.
A Journey Further#080.dst: 右クリックで祭壇の刃を手に取る。

A Journey Further#081.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#081.dst: さあ…俺を斬ってくれ。俺の魂が門を開く…
A Journey Further#081.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#083.dst: うっ…俺のことを…心配…しないで…
A Journey Further#083.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#084.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#084.dst: お前なら…できる…って…分かってる。
A Journey Further#084.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#086.dst: 俺たちを、み、見ている怪物を…
A Journey Further#086.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#090.src: Talk to me when you are ready to go. But remember, we're on a mission. We won't be returning until it's finished.
A Journey Further#090.dst: 行く準備ができたら、声をかけてくれ。でも忘れないで、俺たちは任務中なんだ。それが終わるまでは戻らない。
A Journey Further#090.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#091.src: Aledar probably wouldn't like it if you left.
A Journey Further#091.dst: あなたが去る事を Aledar はおそらく気に入らないだろう。

A Journey Further#092.src: Kill {~} Upside Downer  to Destroy the Spikes
A Journey Further#092.dst: Upside Downerを{~}体倒してトゲを破壊しよう

A Journey Further#093.src: It appears that green substance on the walls has bouncing properties.
A Journey Further#093.dst: 壁に付着している緑色の物質には、跳ね返る性質があるようだ。

A Journey Further#094.src: Looks like you're past the spikes. You can see the tower that was visible past them from here. Hopefully there is a way to break the spikes from this side nearby...
A Journey Further#094.dst: トゲのエリアを通り抜けたようだ。ここから、トゲの向こうに見えていた塔が見える。この近くから、こちら側でトゲを破壊する方法があればいいのだが……

A Journey Further#095.src: No matter how hard to try and pull the blade out, it does not budge...
A Journey Further#095.dst: どんなに力を入れて刃を引き抜こうとしても、微動だにしない……

A Journey Further#096.src: It appears the boulder that was once blocking the way is gone...
A Journey Further#096.dst: かつて道をふさいでいた岩が、なくなっているようだ…
